sources.fact: Authoritative current Brownfield entity is LBBD83/HQ, Town Quay Wharf.
The record gives 147 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.54ha.
The record is permissioned with full-planning-permission dated 15 February 2022.
The current record marks the site deliverable.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority and is not a named proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry rather than an exact title or application polygon.
December 2024 Cabinet minutes describe 211 new homes across the combined Town Quay Wharf and Transport House redevelopment projects.
The disposal/head-lease decision covers Town Quay Wharf and Transport House together and is not a 211-home HQ planning permission.
A separate Cabinet decision approved purchase of 62 affordable tenure homes at Town Quay Wharf.
The same decision references 233 affordable units in the broader Abbey Quay development context; 233 is not added to HQ's 147.
Purchase, land transfer and borrowing approvals are finance/asset governance and not title-readback or planning-permission evidence.
No exact current HMLR title topology tying the 147, 62 and combined 211 scopes was verified this wave.

examples.result: HQ remains a current 147-home permissioned Brownfield record.
The combined 211-home disposal programme is not treated as HQ capacity.
The 62 affordable Town Quay homes are not added to 147 without exact scope reconciliation.
The broader 233 Abbey Quay figure is not transferred to HQ.
Long lease and loan approvals are not planning permission.
Asset disposal is not current HMLR proprietor/title topology.
The Brownfield point is not converted into legal parcel geometry.
Promotion remains zero until exact scope/title relations and overlays are verified.
